run_nanosleep_probe: run a BPF kprobe on sys_nanosleep to watch nanosleep syscall invocations
create_bpf_queue: create a BpfQueue with a ctypes Structure type to exfiltrate kernel events to userspace
create_kprobe_decorator: create a kprobe decorator on sys_nanosleep to intercept kernel function calls
read_kernel_memory: read kernel memory safely using probe_read to access pointer arguments from pt_regs
get_current_comm: get the current process comm name using get_current_comm inside a BPF probe function
